home.descriptionA: ʻEnekinia piha piha piha me 6+ mau makahiki o ka ʻike e lawe ana i nā huahana mai nā koi ambiguous i nā ʻōnaehana hana hilinaʻi. Hoʻolālā au i ka hale hoʻolālā ma hope o React, Angular, .NET, Node.js, Java, C#, Go, a me nā noi SQL: nā palena o ka lawelawe maʻemaʻe, nā hiʻohiʻona ʻikepili paʻa, nā ʻōnaehana komo palekana, a Hiki i nā hui ala lawe ke hana me ka hilinaʻi.
home.descriptionB: Hoʻopili kaʻu hana i nā hoʻoholo ʻenehana i nā hopena ʻoihana. Mai kahi SaaS e hoʻohālikelike ana i ke kūkulu ʻana e hoʻohuli ana i ka ʻikepili pālahalaha i mau manaʻo mākaukau i ka poʻe kūʻai aku i nā paena pūnaewele e loaʻa kālā, kūkulu wau i nā polokalamu e pili ana i ke kahe hana, ka pilikia, a ka waiwai ana e pili ana i ka poe e hoohana ana.

takeoff_engine.lens: Pono nā hoʻokomo maʻalahi i kahi kumu hoʻohālike koʻikoʻi: ʻaʻole pono ka ʻae ʻana i nā ʻano hou e nāwaliwali i nā lula helu a ke kumukūʻai i hilinaʻi ai.

inventory_register.summary: He kahe hana kūʻai me Angular a me Node.js e pili ana i nā mea hoʻohana i hōʻoia ʻia, ka pololei o ka waihona, a me ke kahe uku i hoʻohālikelike ʻia.
inventory_register.lens: ʻOi aku ka mīkini kālā ma mua o ka ʻaoʻao uku. Pono nā kuleana, nā hoʻololi waiwai, a me nā kūlana uku i nā palena maopopo e mālama i ke kahe hana i kuleana.

grocery_app.summary: He polokalamu .NET 9 Blazor me nā palena hoʻokele, lawelawe, a me waihona, ka hoʻomau Entity Framework Core, a me ka pūʻulu hoʻāʻo piha.
grocery_app.lens: Loaʻa i ka hoʻokaʻawale kona wahi ke hiki ke hoʻāʻo ʻia nā lula ʻoihana me ke kūʻokoʻa mai ka interface a me ka papa hoʻomau.

payrollobol.summary: Kaʻana like ka hana uku GnuCOBOL me ka waihona nui SQLite pālua komo a me ka pākaukau hana Svelte.
payrollobol.lens: Hoʻomaka ka pololei kālā me ka hōʻike: hana ʻia ka neʻe kālā maopopo e ka helu keneta piha a me nā komo kaulike.

interop.summary: He ʻike ʻapana ʻole ka ʻike ma ka ʻōlelo like ʻole, ʻoi ʻaʻole {languages} ʻōlelo polokalamu a me {patterns} ʻano hana, e ʻimi ana i ka mea e hana ana ma nā palena runtime.
interop.lens: ʻO ka ʻāpana paʻakikī ka ʻaelike ma waena o ka manawa hana: ʻoi aku ka koʻikoʻi o ka hoʻololi ʻikepili, ke ʻano kaʻina, a me ka hoʻokō hou ʻana ma mua o ka syntax.

formatter.summary: He linter a me formatter WebAssembly i kākau ʻia me Zig no JSON, YAML, XML, HTML, TOML, CSV a me TSV. Hana ʻia ka hōʻoia a me ka formatting ma ka polokalamu.
formatter.lens: ʻO ka formatting he mea hilinaʻi: ʻimi me ka ʻōlelo maoli, mālama i ka ʻōlelo a ke kākau, a mālama i nā ʻikepili ma ka mea kipa.

portfolio_website.summary: Ka pūnaewele āu e noho nei: portfolio React me 100+ ʻōlelo, nā pilina hiki ke komo, a me nā mea hana WebAssembly.
portfolio_website.lens: ʻAʻole manaʻo ʻia ka static deployment he ʻike static. Hiki i nā pilina waiwai ke noho ma ka mea kūʻai me ka ʻole he kikowaena polokalamu.

biblioteca.summary: He paipu hoʻololi ʻōlelo Python e hoʻololi ana i hoʻokahi kumu ʻike i portfolio i loaʻa ma 100+ ʻōlelo.
biblioteca.lens: ʻO ka hiki ʻana i ka honua he pilikia mālama ʻikepili e like me ka pilikia unuhi. ʻO hoʻokahi kumu o ka ʻoiaʻiʻo e hoʻomau i nā hoʻololi ʻike i mālama ʻia.

personal_summary.title: Hōʻuluʻulu Pilikino
personal_summary.text: He kanaka ʻenekinia piha piha au i hoʻokumu ʻia ma Orlando, FL nona ke ala mai ka pilikia huahana a i ka hopena hana. Hana wau i nā koho ʻenehana i ka lawelawe ʻana o ka ʻōnaehana: .NET a me Entity Framework Core ke loaʻa kahi kahua paʻa i kūkulu ʻia a me ka hoʻāʻo hoʻomau; Angular a i ʻole React ke paʻakikī pono nā kaʻina hana i kahi kikowaena mālama; Node.js a i ʻole E hele inā pono kahi API, hoʻohui, a i ʻole mea hana kiʻekiʻe e pono ai ka manawa holo. Ma waena o nā huahana SaaS, nā kahe hana kūloko, a me nā paepae e kū nei i nā mea kūʻai aku, ke alakaʻi nei au me nā kālepa kūʻokoʻa, ka hoʻolālā paʻa a paʻa, ka hoʻāʻo ʻana, a me nā hana hoʻopuka. kōkua i nā hui e hoʻouna i nā polokalamu waiwai me ka haʻalele ʻole i ka ʻaiʻē hana.

entries.title: ʻEnekinia Hui Pū ʻIa piha
entries.text: Ke alakaʻi nei au i ka hāʻawi ʻana i ka huahana hope-to-end: unuhi i nā kahe hana ʻoihana i nā palena ʻōnaehana, nā hiʻohiʻona ʻikepili, nā API, a me nā pilina, a laila e lawe i ka hana ma o ka hoʻāʻo ʻana, hoʻolaha, a me ka ike hou ana. ʻO ka pahuhopu ka polokalamu e hiki ai i kahi hui ke hoʻololi a hana, ʻaʻole ka hōʻiliʻili o nā pale i hoʻokaʻawale ʻia.

entries.title: Huahana & Papahana Hoʻolālā
entries.text: Koho au i nā paepae a me nā hiʻohiʻona e pili ana i ka pilikia: nā lawelawe .NET layered no nā kāʻei kapu ʻoihana, nā ʻāpana-driven Angular a i ʻole React nā noi no nā hana paʻakikī, pili pili. nā hiʻohiʻona ʻikepili no nā kahe hana kūpono, a me nā hoʻohui i hoʻolālā ʻia me nā ʻano hana ʻole, ka mana ʻae, a me ka mālama ʻana i ka noʻonoʻo.

entries.title: Hoʻolaha-Makaukau Hoʻouna
entries.text: Ke kūkulu nei au me nā mea ʻoiaʻiʻo ma hope o ka hoʻomaka ʻana i ka ʻike: nā mea huna i mālama ʻia ma waho o ka mana kumu, nā ala neʻe i ka ʻikepili kikoʻī, ka mana e pili ana i ke kuleana, ka hōʻoia ʻana i nā palena ʻōnaehana, nā hoʻokolohua automated, CI/CD ʻike, a me ka nānā pono. ʻO kēia nā kikoʻī e hoʻohuli i kahi prototype i polokalamu hilinaʻi.

biblioteca.title: Biblioteca JSON
biblioteca.text: ʻO kahi pipeline localization e pili ana i ka Python e hoʻohuli i kahi kumu ʻike i kūkulu ʻia i loko o kahi kōpili hiki ke hiki i ka honua. Mālama ʻo ia i ka ʻikepili unuhi ma ke ʻano he ʻōnaehana hiki ke mālama ʻia ma mua o ke kope kope ʻaoʻao me ka lima, e ʻae ana i ka paena e hoʻonui i nā ʻōlelo he 100+ a hiki i ka honua holoʻokoʻa. hiki ke hana ma kahi o kahi hiʻohiʻona hoʻokahi manawa.

connect_four.title: Hoʻohui ʻEhā
connect_four.text: He ʻohana nui o {implementations} hoʻokō o ka pāʻani ʻEhā i ka lālani. Uhi ka papahana i {languages} ʻōlelo hoʻonohonoho, me ka Java, C++, Python, a me JavaScript, a me {frameworks} mau framework, waihona, manawa hana, a me nā waihona ʻikepili, mai React, Angular, a me Blazor a i Django, Spring Boot, Phoenix, PostgreSQL, a me nā mea i mua.

grocery_app.title: Mea kūʻai meaʻai
grocery_app.text: ʻO kahi polokalamu kikowaena .NET 9 Blazor Server e hōʻike ana i ka hoʻolālā hope hope no kahi kaʻina hana ʻoihana. Mālama ka mea hoʻoponopono / lawelawe / waihona i nā lula no ka noi, ka ʻike ʻikepili, a me ka hōʻike kūʻokoʻa e hoʻāʻo ʻia; Hāʻawi ka Entity Framework Core i ka hoʻomau lōʻihi; a me ka Mālama ka hui hoʻāʻo piha i ka hana i ka wā e ulu ai ka huahana.

interop.title: Pāhana Interop
interop.text: He reference interoperability cross-language e pili ana i {languages} mau ʻōlelo papahana a me {patterns} mau kumu hoʻokō. Ke noiʻi nei ka papahana i ka palena kahi e lilo ai nā ʻōnaehana i mea palupalu: kaʻina hana ʻaelike, hoʻololi ʻikepili, hana manawa holo, a me nā ala hoʻohui hou. Hōʻike ia i ka noʻonoʻo ʻana o nā ʻōnaehana inā ʻoi aku ka nui o kahi huahana ma mua o kahi waihona hoʻokahi.

inventory_register.title: Kakau inoa
inventory_register.text: ʻO kahi POS piha piha a me ka papa hana waihona i kūkulu ʻia me Angular 17+ a me Node.js. Hoʻohālike ia i nā hopohopo hana o kahi ʻōnaehana B2B: nā mea hoʻohana i hōʻoiaʻiʻo ʻia, ka mana o ke komo ʻana i ke kuleana, ka pololei o ka waihona kālā, a me ke kahe uku hoʻohenehene. Hoʻolālā ʻia ka pāhana e pili ana i ka hana maoli a kahi hui kākau inoa e hana ai, ʻaʻole wale he papa inoa o nā hiʻohiʻona framework.

payrollobol.title: PayrollOBOL
payrollobol.text: He ʻōnaehana hana uku kūloko i kūkulu ʻia me GnuCOBOL, waihona nui SQLite pālua komo, a me ka pākaukau hana Svelte. Hoʻohana ia i ka helu keneta piha, ka hana uku pūʻulu, a me ka pākaukau loopback e hoʻomaopopo a hoʻāʻo a kuleana i nā kahe kālā.

formatter.title: Auto-Linter
formatter.text: ʻO Auto-Linter kahi linter a me ka formatter no JSON, YAML, XML, HTML, TOML, CSV a me TSV. Hoʻopili ka ʻenekini Zig i WebAssembly a holo holoʻokoʻa i ka polokalamu kele pūnaewele: hōʻoia me nā parser maoli, hoʻopili hou i nā palapala me ka ʻole o ka kākau hou ʻana i kā lākou mau ʻike, a mālama i nā manaʻo, heleuma, CDATA, quoting a me ka pololei helu. Hoʻolālā ka papahana i ʻekolu hoʻokō - Go, Rust a me Zig - me nā mana mua i hoʻopaʻa ʻia no ka hoʻohālikelike.

takeoff_engine.title: ʻEnekini Haʻalele
takeoff_engine.text: ʻO kahi kūkulu e manaʻo ana i ka SaaS i kūkulu ʻia a puni kahi kaʻina hana aelike pili i ka hewa. Hoʻokomo ka huahana React + Express i ka ʻikepili CSV a me Excel, palapala ʻāina i nā kolamu like ʻole i loko o kahi ʻano hoʻohālike domain hoʻohana, helu ʻia ka ʻeli ʻauwaha a me ka nui o ka hana honua, kaʻi ʻana i ka hana a markup, a hoʻopuka i nā manaʻo PDF a me Word. ʻO kēia ka ʻenehana holoʻokoʻa huahana piha: ka hoʻokaʻawale ʻana i ka ʻikepili, nā lula helu, kahi kaila hana hoʻopololei, a me nā mea hoʻopakele e kōkua i ka neʻe ʻana o kahi ʻoihana mai nā hoʻokomo maka i kahi bid.

minecraft_json_generator.title: Minecraft JSON mea hana
minecraft_json_generator.text: ʻO ka mea hana JSON māmā i kūkulu ʻia ma Python no nā kumuwaiwai Minecraft & pūʻulu ʻikepili. Hoʻohana ʻia kēia papahana e hoʻopuka i nā faila JSON no nā mods Minecraft, me nā mea maʻamau, nā poloka, a me nā hui. Maikaʻi loa no ka hana ʻana i nā ʻikepili maʻamau, akā no nā mods pū kekahi ma o ka hiʻohiʻona hoʻololi inoa mod.

educational_experience.title: ʻO kaʻu ʻike hoʻonaʻauao
educational_experience.text: Me kaʻu mau papahana pilikino, ua loaʻa iaʻu nā mākau he nui mai ka ʻike hoʻonaʻauao. Kaomi ma aneʻi e ʻike i kaʻu ʻaoʻao LinkedIn no ka ʻike hou aku.

professional_experience.title: ʻO kaʻu ʻike ʻoihana
professional_experience.text: ʻEono mau makahiki o ka ʻike ʻenehana ʻoihana ma waena o nā hui huahana, nā kahua pāʻoihana, a me nā polokalamu kūʻai aku. Ua komo kaʻu hana i ke kūkulu ʻana i nā papa noi hiki ke mālama ʻia, ka hui pū ʻana ma waena o nā hoʻopaʻapaʻa lawe, a me ka hana ʻana i nā hoʻoholo ʻenehana me ke ola o ka huahana, ka hana. pilikia, a me ka noho 'ana no ka manawa loihi.

portfolio_website.title: ʻO Patrick Goodwin Pūnaewele Pūnaewele
portfolio_website.text: ʻO kahi waihona React noʻonoʻo hana e mālama i ka hiki a me ka hiki ʻana i ka honua e like me nā koi ʻenehana. Loaʻa iā ia kahi paipu unuhi hiki ke mālama ʻia no 100+ mau ʻōlelo, nā mea paahana pili i kākoʻo ʻia e WebAssembly, nā ʻano UI pane a hiki ke loaʻa, a me kahi hoʻolālā papahana. i hoʻolālā ʻia e ulu i ka wā e hoʻouna ʻia ai nā hana hou.

scripting_library.title: Ka hale waihona script
scripting_library.text: He waihona hoʻohui ʻia o nā palapala ʻomi, me hoʻokahi ʻaoʻao no kēlā me kēia ʻōlelo: VBA no nā pāpalapala Excel, Lua no nā mea hana māmā, PowerShell no ka hoʻokele Windows, Python no ka hana ʻikepili i kēlā me kēia lā, a me Ruby no nā hoʻokolohua palapala. Kākau ʻia kēlā me kēia palapala e hoʻohana hou ʻia, no laila mālama ʻia ka hōʻiliʻili ʻana ma ke ʻano he papahana hoʻokahi ma mua o ʻelima mau waihona hoʻopuehu.

neovim_config.title: ʻO Patrick's Neovim Config
neovim_config.text: ʻO kaʻu hoʻonohonoho Neovim pilikino. Hoʻohana ʻia kēia papahana no ka hoʻonohonoho ʻana iā Neovim i koʻu makemake, me nā kī kī maʻamau, nā kumumanaʻo, a me nā plugins. Hoʻohana ʻia kēia papahana no ka hoʻohana ʻana iā Neovim i mea hoʻohana a maikaʻi no kaʻu hoʻohana pilikino.

python_maps.title: Patrick's Map Generator
python_maps.text: ʻO kahi mea hana hōʻike geospatial Python i kūkulu ʻia me GeoPandas a me Matplotlib e hoʻohua i nā kalana US a me nā palapala 'āina. Hoʻololi ia i ka ʻikepili kikoʻī i mau mea kikoʻī hiki ke heluhelu ʻia, e hōʻike ana i kahi noʻonoʻo pipeline data: koho i nā hale waihona puke kūpono, hoʻomaʻamaʻa i nā mea hoʻokomo, a hana i nā mea hoʻopuka. kākoʻo i nā hoʻoholo maopopo.

pdf_builder.title: Mea hana akamai PDF
pdf_builder.text: ʻO kahi kahe hana hana palapala i kūkulu ʻia me Python, Pdfkit, Jinja2, HTML, a me ka ʻikepili JSON i kūkulu ʻia. Hoʻokaʻawale ia i nā ʻikepili hiki ke hoʻohana hou ʻia mai nā hōʻike hōʻike e hoʻohua i nā PDF i hoʻopaʻa ʻia i ka manawa mau, kahi kumu kūpono no ka hōʻemi ʻana i ka hana lima a me ka hana ʻana i nā palapala ʻoihana. hiki ke hana hou.

rijndael_encryption.title: Ka papahana paʻa Rijndael
rijndael_encryption.text: He pūʻulu hoʻohālikelike o {implementations} Rijndael hoʻokō ma waena o nā ʻano like ʻole 128-, 192-, a me 256-bit. ʻO ka hoʻokō hou ʻana i kahi algorithm e pili ana i ka palekana ma waena o nā ʻōlelo he hoʻomaʻamaʻa aʻo ʻia i nā kikoʻī kikoʻī, nā ʻano hiki ke hoʻāʻo ʻia, a me nā palena o ka lawe ʻana i ka pae ʻōlelo, nā manaʻo pono āpau no nā ʻōnaehana e mālama i ka ʻikepili koʻikoʻi.

suprememc.title: SupremeMC Minecraft Mod
suprememc.text: He mod Minecraft e hoʻohui ana i nā mea hana, nā mea kaua, nā mobs, nā blocks, nā ana, a me nā hiʻohiʻona kūikawā hou aku i ka pāʻani. Kūkulu ʻia me Java a me Kotlin ka nui, e kākoʻo ana i nā mana Minecraft 1.16 a i 26.2.

rubix_cube_solver.title: Ka hōʻoia Rubik's Cube
rubix_cube_solver.text: ʻO kahi 3D Rubik's Cube pāʻani āu e pena ai i ka sticker ma ka sticker - ma ka cube pono'ī a i ʻole ma kāna ʻupena i wehe ʻia - a laila e hoʻoponopono me kahi hulina ʻelua ʻano Herbert Kociemba i hōʻuluʻulu ʻia mai Rust a i WebAssembly. Hāʻawi ka Svelte interface i ka cube me three.js, mālama i ka mokuʻāina pena, kona hōʻoia ʻana, a me ke kaula facelet o ka solver i ka sync, a hoʻokani i ka hoʻonā hoʻi i ka neʻe ʻana ma kahi kaʻina manawa hiki iā ʻoe ke holoi, hele a pāʻani hou.

snake.title: Pāʻani nahesa
snake.text: He mīkini Nahesa maikaʻi i kūkulu ʻia me Rust a me Macroquad, hoʻopili ʻia i WebAssembly, a hōʻike ʻia ma o HTML5 Canvas. Hoʻohui ia i nā tick pāʻani 0.12-kekona maopopo me ka neʻe interpolated maʻemaʻe, nā pae pāʻani maopopo, ka hoʻomalu pane, ka hoʻokele paʻa a me nā kūlana lanakila, a me kahi pūʻulu hoʻāʻo e uhi ana i nā lula kumu o ka pāʻani.

rustcraft.title: Rustcraft
rustcraft.text: He pāʻani voxel kaila Minecraft i kūkulu ʻia ma Rust me wgpu a hoʻohui ʻia i WebAssembly, no laila ke pāʻani pololei nei i ka polokalamu kele pūnaewele. ʻO ia ke kūkulu ʻia ʻana o ka pahu pahu pahu: ʻāina poloka a me ka honua voxel i huki ʻia ma o ka pipeline kiʻi kiʻi hou, i kākau ʻia mai ka ʻohi ʻana ma luna o ka mea hana Rust ma mua o ka ʻenekini pāʻani.

tiger_programming_language.title: ʻŌlelo Papahana Tiger
tiger_programming_language.text: He ʻōlelo hoʻolālā maʻamau a me ka unuhi ʻōlelo i kūkulu ʻia ma Rust e ʻimi i ka hoʻolālā manawa holo ʻōlelo, ka hana hoʻokō, a me nā kālepa hana. Loaʻa ka unuhi ʻōlelo Go kumu ma ke ʻano he hoʻokō hoʻoilina. ʻO ka hōʻuluʻulu ʻana iā WebAssembly a me ka hoʻohui ʻana iā ia i loko o ka waihona e hana i kahi ʻili huahana maoli a nānā ʻia no ka ʻenekini pae ʻōnaehana ma mua o ka waiho ʻana i ka hana ma ke ʻano he hoʻokolohua waihona wale nō.

tiger_tailgating_pros.title: Paena pūnaewele ʻo Tiger Tailgating Pros
tiger_tailgating_pros.text: Hāʻawi ʻia kahi pūnaewele React no kahi ʻoihana tailgating Clemson, SC. Unuhi ka hana i ka hāʻawi ʻana o kahi ʻoihana liʻiliʻi i kahi huakaʻi kūʻai maʻalahi a me ka noho pūnaewele hilinaʻi, e noi ana i ka noʻonoʻo huahana e kōkua i kahi hui maoli e hoʻohuli i ka hoihoi. i ka ninau a me ka loaa.

turing_machine.title: Papahana Mīkini Turing
turing_machine.text: He ʻohana {implementations} o ka Turing Machine. Pono ʻia e hōʻike i ka turing completeness o nā ʻōlelo polokalamu like ʻole no ka ʻimi naʻauao, ʻoi aku ka ʻōlelo Tiger.

alkalab.title: Alkalab
alkalab.text: He hale hana kemika pauka-one i kūkulu ʻia ma Rust a hoʻopili ʻia i WebAssembly. E pena i ke one, ka wai, ka lāva, ke kila, ka calcium carbide, a i ʻole kahi ʻāpana sodium a e nānā i ka hakakā ʻana o ka physics a me ka kemika: pahū ka sodium i ka wai, hoʻokuʻu ka calcium carbide i ka acetylene, hoʻoheheʻe ka lāva i ke one i aniani, a ʻo ka nuipaʻa wale nō ka mea e hoʻokaʻawale i ka ʻaila, ka mercury, a me ke one. Hoʻokele ka mīkini i 32 mea a me 40 lula hoʻopalapala ma luna o kahi pahu cell palahalaha, e hōʻike pololei ana i nā pixel mai ka waihona laina wasm me ka ʻole kope no kēlā me kēia frame.

chess_engine.title: Ka ʻōnaehana pāʻahikī
chess_engine.text: He mīkini chess i kākau ʻia ma Rust a hōʻuluʻulu ʻia i WebAssembly. Huli ia me ka negamax hoʻonui hou ʻana, ka ʻohi alpha-beta, kahi papa transposition 32 MB a me ka huli ʻana i nā lau; loiloi ia me nā papa ʻāpana ʻāpana ʻāpana a me nā kauoha i neʻe ʻia e MVV-LVA, nā mea pepehi a me ka mōʻaukala. Holo ka ʻenekini i loko o kahi Web Worker no laila ʻaʻole maloʻo ka papa, a nānā ʻia kāna mea hoʻoneʻe neʻe ma ka polokalamu kele i nā helu perft i paʻi ʻia - 20, 400, 8,902, 197,281 a me 4,865,609 nodes no nā hohonu ʻelima mua.

reclaim_4160.title: Reclaim 4160
reclaim_4160.text: ʻO ka Reclaim 4160 kahi papahana hoʻihoʻi: ʻo ka mea i hoʻomaka i ka pāʻani CPSC 4160 hapalua i hoʻopau ʻia ma ke kulanui - hopu i nā ʻōwili pepa hope loa a hiki i ka hale kūʻai ma mua o ka hoʻopau ʻana o nā germs iā ʻoe - ua kūkulu hou ʻia mai ka wā ʻōpala e like me ka mīkini C ++ 20 hou ma SDL2 a hoʻohui ʻia i WebAssembly. Hoʻouna ʻo ia i nā aisles piʻi he ʻumi me ka patrolling a me ka hahai ʻana i ka germ AI, pickups, particles and touch controls, ʻaʻohe o nā pōkole o ka prototype kumu.

pit_matching_engine.text: He ʻenekini hoʻohālikelike puke palena palena hiki ke hoʻokani hou ʻia. ʻO ka ʻenekini ponoʻī he Ruby maʻemaʻe ʻaʻohe Rails i loko, lawelawe ʻia e Rails 8 ma luna o kahi faila SQLite hoʻokahi. Hoʻopili ʻia kēlā me kēia kauoha i kahi moʻolelo kākau mua ma mua o ka ʻike ʻana o ka ʻenekini, no laila, ʻo ka mokuʻāina o ka puke i hala hoʻokahi paʻi, a ua hōʻoia ʻia ka hana hou ʻana ma ka hoʻohālikelike ʻana i nā manamana lima i hoʻopaʻa ʻia i ka wā e ola ana ka mākeke. ʻO ke kumu kūʻai-manawa mua, GTC/IOC/FOK, e hoʻololi i ka mālama ʻana a i ʻole ka nalo ʻana i ke kūlana queue, a ʻo ka pale ʻana i ke kālepa ponoʻī e ʻōlelo ʻia e nā ʻumikūmāhā invariants ma hope o kēlā me kēia kauoha i loko o kahi hui fuzz seeded. Loaʻa i ka polokalamu kele pūnaewele he ʻumi-hertz alapiʻi ma luna o Action Cable, aʻo nā kauoha e piʻi ma luna o HTTP.
pit_matching_engine.title: Ka ʻōnaehana hōʻoia PIT

contact.description: Pane wau i nā nīnau mai ka leka uila a me nā leka LinkedIn. E kelepona hou au inā hāʻawi ʻia kaʻu helu ma o ka resume a i ʻole, ʻoiai makemake wau e hūnā i kaʻu helu kelepona.

formatter.title: Auto-Linter
formatter.description: ʻO Auto-Linter kahi mea hoʻohana pono ʻikepili e pili ana i ka polokalamu kele pūnaewele e hōʻoia a hoʻohālikelike iā JSON, YAML, XML, HTML, TOML, CSV a me TSV me kahi ʻenekini Zig i hōʻuluʻulu ʻia i WebAssembly. Noho ʻo Parsing ma kahi kokoke i ka mea hoʻohana no ka wikiwiki a me ka manaʻo pilikino ʻoiai ke hoʻokō nei i nā lula syntax maoli ma ka palena ʻikepili. Mālama ʻo ia i ka kikokikona a ka mea kākau, hōʻole i ka hoʻokomo hewa ʻana, a hōʻike i ke ʻano e hiki ai i kahi ʻāpana WebAssembly liʻiliʻi ke hoʻoikaika i kahi kaila hana hoʻomohala hilinaʻi.

tiger.title: ʻŌlelo Tiga
tiger.description: ʻO Tiger kahi ʻōlelo papahana maʻamau a me kahi unuhi unuhi Rust i kūkulu ʻia no ka hana. ʻO kāna ʻenekini bytecode i hui pū ʻia a me ka unuhi ʻōlelo hele lāʻau e noho ma ka lockstep ma waena o kahi benchmark corpus 44-program, a mālama ka protocol in-process i ka manawa holo ma mua a i ʻole ma mua o CPython ma kēlā me kēia ʻāpana i ʻōlelo ʻia, me ka hana e hoʻokūkū pololei me Python a me Ruby no ka kākau ʻana i kēlā me kēia lā. Loaʻa ka unuhi ʻōlelo Go kumu ma ke ʻano he hoʻokō hoʻoilina. ʻO ka hōʻuluʻulu ʻana i ka unuhi ʻōlelo iā WebAssembly e hoʻololi i nā ʻōnaehana e hana i kahi huahana pili, polokalamu kele pūnaewele: hiki i nā mea hoʻohana ke hoʻokō pololei i nā papahana ʻoiai e hoʻomau ʻia ka wā holo a kaʻawale mai ka noi hoʻokipa.
